success_criteria.criterion: Pass first CPU-vs-hybrid coverage-output equivalence for the scoped RTL proxy control contract.
success_criteria.verification: coverage_output_equivalence passed for 21 strict output words / 84 bytes with zero mismatches at cfg_batch_length_i=32.
